security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Package GGUF models into single-file llamafiles
bundle.longDescription: Llamafile Studio is a visual compiler for Mozilla's llamafile. Pick a base runtime and a GGUF model, write a persona, tune GPU/CPU/context settings and produce a single, standalone, double-clickable .llamafile executable - no command line required.
